blocks.text: Sullivan Station homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

Sullivan Station, September 2026. Detached houses: 93 listed at month end and 6 sold in September, a sales ratio of 6% (a buyers’ market). Condos and townhomes: 128 listed at month end and 10 sold in September, a sales ratio of 8% (a buyers’ market).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, detached houses sold 29 over 4 months against an average of 92.0 listed, about 12.7 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was July with 11 sold. condos and townhomes sold 84 over 4 months against an average of 132.8 listed, about 6.3 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 34 sold.
